mapper.select: SELECT S.SIGNIFICANT_MEMO , S.SIGNIFICANT_NO FROM significant S WHERE S.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} ORDER BY S.CRT_DT DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT VR.VACNTN_INOCL_DT , VM.MTH_NM , V.VACNTN_CNT FROM vacntn_rcord VR LEFT OUTER JOIN vacntn V ON VR.VACNTN_NO = V.VACNTN_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN vacntn_mth VM ON VM.VACNTN_MTH_NO = V.VACNTN_MTH_NO WHERE VR.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} ORDER BY VACNTN_INOCL_DT DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT PD.DRUG_NM , PD.DRUG_UNIT , PD.DRUG_AMOUNT FROM mdexmn_rcord MR LEFT OUTER JOIN prscrptn P ON MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_NO = P.MDEXMN_RCORD_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN prscrptn_drug PD ON PD.PRSCRPTN_NO = P.PRSCRPTN_NO WHERE MR.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} AND MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_DT = ( SELECT MAX(MR2.MDEXMN_RCORD_DT) FROM mdexmn_rcord MR2 WHERE MR2.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} )

SELECT MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_DT AS mdexmnRcordDt , H.dutyName AS dutyName , MR.MDEXMN_DOCTR_OPINION , MR.MDEXMN_DGNSS_NM , MR.MDEXMN_MDLRT , MR.MDEXMN_MEMO , MR.MDEXMN_TY , MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_NO , ( SELECT A.ATCH_FLPTH FROM atch A WHERE A.ATCH_CODE = P.ATCH_CODE ) AS mdexmnRcordatchFlpth , ( SELECT P2.PARMACY_NM FROM parmacy P2 WHERE P2.PARMACY_NO = P.PARMACY_NO ) AS parmacyNm FROM mdexmn_rcord MR LEFT OUTER JOIN hsptl H ON H.id = MR.HSPTL_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN prscrptn P ON MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_NO = P.MDEXMN_RCORD_NO WHERE MR.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} ORDER BY MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_DT DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT U.URINE_TY AS urineTy , COUNT(*) AS urineCount , DATE(U.CRT_DT) AS urineCrtDt , U.URINE_NO FROM urine U WHERE U.CRT_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) GROUP BY U.URINE_TY , urineCrtDt , U.URINE_NO

WITH MealIntervals AS ( SELECT DATE(M.CRT_DT) AS recordDate , TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, LAG(M.CRT_DT) OVER ( PARTITION BY DATE(M.CRT_DT) ORDER BY M.CRT_DT ) , M.CRT_DT ) AS intervalSeconds , M.MEAL_TY AS mealTy , M.MEAL_NO AS mealNo FROM meal M WHERE M.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} ) SELECT recordDate AS mealCrtDt , COUNT(*) AS mealCount , AVG(intervalSeconds) / 3600 AS avgIntervalHours , mealTy , mealNo FROM MealIntervals WHERE recordDate >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND mealTy = #{mealTy} GROUP BY recordDate, mealTy, mealNo ORDER BY recordDate DESC

WITH SleepIntervals AS ( SELECT DATE(s.CRT_DT) AS recordDate , S.SLEEP_BGNDT , S.SLEEP_NO AS sleepNo , S.SLEEP_ENDDT , TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, LAG(S.SLEEP_BGNDT) OVER ( PARTITION BY DATE(S.CRT_DT) ORDER BY S.SLEEP_BGNDT) , S.SLEEP_BGNDT ) AS intervalSeconds , CASE WHEN S.SLEEP_ENDDT >= S.SLEEP_BGNDT THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, S.SLEEP_BGNDT, S.SLEEP_ENDDT) / 3600 ELSE NULL END AS sleepDuration FROM sleep S ) SELECT recordDate , COUNT(*) AS sleepCount , AVG(intervalSeconds) / 3600 AS avgIntervalHours , AVG(sleepDuration) AS avgSleepHours , sleepNo FROM SleepIntervals WHERE recordDate >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) GROUP BY recordDate , sleepNo ORDER BY recordDate DESC

SELECT DATE(B.CRT_DT) AS recordDate , AVG(B.BDHEAT_TP) AS avgBdheat , B.BDHEAT_NO FROM bdheat B WHERE B.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} AND B.CRT_DT >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND B.CRT_DT < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE(B.CRT_DT) , B.BDHEAT_NO ORDER BY recordDate DESC

SELECT ( SELECT S.SYMPTMS_NM FROM symptms S WHERE S.SYMPTMS_NO = CS.SYMPTMS_NO ) AS symptmsNm FROM chldrn_symptms CS WHERE CS.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} AND DATE(CS.CRT_DT) = CURDATE() ORDER BY CS.CRT_DT DESC

SELECT C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY , C.CHLDRN_NM , C.ATCH_CODE , C.CHLDRN_NO , ( SELECT A.ATCH_FLPTH FROM atch A WHERE A.ATCH_CODE = C.ATCH_CODE ) AS atchFlpth , MAX(CI.CHLDRN_HEIGHT) AS chldrnHeight , MAX(CI.CHLDRN_BDWGH) AS chldrnBdwgh , MAX(CI.CHLDRN_HEAD) AS chldrnHead ,CASE WHEN date_format(C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY, '%M%D') > date_format(curdate(), '%M%D') THEN year(curdate()) - year(C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY) END AS age ,floor(datediff(curdate(), C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY) / 7) AS weeks ,mod(datediff(curdate(), C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY), 7) AS days FROM chldrn C LEFT OUTER JOIN chldrn_info CI ON CI.CHLDRN_NO = C.CHLDRN_NO WHERE C.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo}

SELECT T.TAKNG_ENDDT , T.TAKNG_DT , T.TAKNG_MDCIN_NM , T.TAKNG_MDCIN_AMT , T.TAKNG_MDCIN_UNIT , C.CHLDRN_NM , DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), STR_TO_DATE(C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY,'%Y%m%d')) AS dday , CASE WHEN T.TAKNG_MDCIN_TY = 'LIQD' THEN '물약' WHEN T.TAKNG_MDCIN_TY = 'POWD' THEN '가루약' WHEN T.TAKNG_MDCIN_TY = 'PILL' THEN '알약' END AS takngMdcinTy FROM takng T LEFT OUTER JOIN chldrn C ON T.CHLDRN_NO = C.CHLDRN_NO WHERE T.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrn} ORDER BY T.CRT_DT DESC

SELECT B.BDHEAT_TP , B.BDHEAT_MEMO , B.BDHEAT_BGNDT , B.BDHEAT_ENDDT , C.CHLDRN_NM , B.CRT_DT AS bdheatCrtDt , DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), STR_TO_DATE(C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY,'%Y%m%d')) AS dday FROM bdheat B LEFT OUTER JOIN chldrn C ON C.CHLDRN_NO = B.CHLDRN_NO WHERE B.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrn}

SELECT CASE WHEN M.MEAL_TY = 'MHRSM' THEN '모유' WHEN M.MEAL_TY = 'BABYFD' THEN '분유' WHEN M.MEAL_TY = 'FOMULA' THEN '이유식' END AS mealTy , M.MEAL_NO , C.CHLDRN_NM , M.MEAL_UNIT , M.MEAL_AMOUNT , DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), STR_TO_DATE(C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY,'%Y%m%d')) AS dday FROM meal M LEFT OUTER JOIN chldrn C ON C.CHLDRN_NO = M.CHLDRN_NO WHERE M.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrn} ORDER BY M.CRT_DT DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN U.URINE_TY = 'PEE' THEN '소변' WHEN U.URINE_TY = 'POO' THEN '대변' ELSE '알수없음' END AS urineTy , U.CRT_DT AS URINECRTDT , C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY , U.URINE_NO , C.CHLDRN_NM , DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), STR_TO_DATE(C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY,'%Y%m%d')) AS dday FROM urine U LEFT OUTER JOIN chldrn C ON C.CHLDRN_NO = U.CHLDRN_NO WHERE U.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrn} ORDER BY U.CRT_DT DESC

SELECT S.CRT_DT AS SLEEPCRTDT , S.SLEEP_BGNDT , S.SLEEP_ENDDT , C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY , C.CHLDRN_NM , S.SLEEP_NO , DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), STR_TO_DATE(C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY,'%Y%m%d')) AS dday FROM sleep S LEFT OUTER JOIN chldrn C ON C.CHLDRN_NO = S.CHLDRN_NO WHERE S.CHLDRN_NO =#{chldrn} ORDER BY S.CRT_DT DESC

SELECT CI.CHLDRN_HEIGHT , CI.CHLDRN_BDWGH , CI.CRT_DT AS chldrnInfoCrtDt , C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY , CI.CHLDRN_INFO_NO , DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), STR_TO_DATE(C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY,'%Y%m%d')) AS dday FROM chldrn_info CI LEFT OUTER JOIN chldrn C ON CI.CHLDRN_NO = C.CHLDRN_NO WHERE CI.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrn} ORDER BY CI.CRT_DT DESC
